text:
jen: FYI release branch CI red after regen. Tiny change in generated enums caused sample-app snapshot to fail. Seems like ordering changed, now CI forces a minor version bump.

omar: link: <https://ci.internal/redwood/1987/build>. regendiff artifact shows enum member order flipped.

ci-bot: build 1987 failed at step `typegen-regenerate` - artifact: <https://ci.internal/artifacts/1987/regendiff.txt> :warning:

lucy: pasted diff since some folks can't reach CI: 
```diff
-export enum UserRole {
-  ADMIN = "admin",
-  MEMBER = "member",
-  GUEST = "guest",
-}
+export enum UserRole {
+  MEMBER = "member",
+  GUEST = "guest",
+  ADMIN = "admin",
+}
```

rachel: sample-app tests assert exact enum snapshot in `examples/samplekit/src/__snapshots__/roles.snap`. That explains failures.

sam: weird that enum ordering is changing; we intentionally avoid relying on object key order. Could be upstream openapi->ts tool that uses Object.keys order.

jen: i ran `yarn regen` locally and got same order as CI. But others (lucy) saw original ordering locally. environment differences again. Node 18 vs 20? OS locale?

omar: i reproduced with a docker image matching CI (node:18.14). Steps:
```bash
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work node:18.14-bullseye bash -lc "yarn; yarn regen --ci"
```
regendiff appears.

lucy: dug into package-lock. openapi-to-typescript bumped from 6.1.0 -> 6.2.4 in CI resolution. That explains nondet behaviour.

devx-bot: automated note: release-bot will classify PRs as `semver: minor` if generated types change. See <https://docs.internal/devex/regendiff-policy>.

jen: two parallel proposals: (A) pin openapi-to-typescript in the release branch until upstream fixes, run regen CI job early in the pipeline so PRs fail fast; (B) teach regendiff scanner to ignore pure ordering changes (i.e., compare sets not order) and only mark semver when types/values changed. Tradeoffs?

sam: B reduces noise but could mask real breaking changes if order semantics matter (some clients rely on enum order in UI). But we shouldn't rely on key order. Maybe add an explicit `// @regendiff-ignore-order` directive in OpenAPI extensions for schemas we know are order-insensitive.

omar: temporary fix: opened PR #2522 to pin openapi-to-typescript to 6.1.0 on the release branch. Running samplekit CI now.

ci-bot: PR #2522 CI triggered (job 2001). artifact: <https://ci.internal/artifacts/2001/regendiff-proof.txt>.

lucy: after pin, sample-app snapshots passed in CI job 2001. +1 to pin short-term. We should notify the SDK maintainers and upstream.

jen: action items: 1) merge pin PR for release branch, 2) add note in release playbook to always run regen in the CI container image, 3) add a small script `tools/regendiff-normalize` to canonicalize ordering for comparison, 4) discuss a long-term fix with infra (stableSort in typegen pipeline).

rachel: also adding a quick doc snippet for sample-app maintainers: avoid inline snapshot tests that assert enum order. Prefer value-based checks or sorted snapshots.

release-bot: label applied: `semver: patch` (automation override because change was ordering-only and pin PR unchanged public API).

jen: great. thanks everyone. i'll draft the release note blurb explaining why we pinned and when we plan to revert. Keep eyes on upstream fixes. :rocket:
